item.title: New Video Shows ICE Agent’s Perspective Seconds Before Minneapolis Shooting

item.title: ALFREDO ORTIZ: America’s Labor Market Turning A Corner Led By Main Street And GOP Policies
item.description: Friday's jobs report shows the American labor market is turning a corner. The unemployment rate fell to 4.4%, and average wages grew 40% faster than inflation. Rising real wages are a stark contrast to the Biden administration, where 25% inflation caused an affordability crisis that President Donald Trump and Republicans are digging us out from.
